scenes.text: Have you ever heard of the mysterious place in America where you could theoretically get away with committing a major crime?
It is called the Zone of Death, a fifty-square-mile strip of land in Yellowstone National Park where a mind-blowing constitutional loophole technically leaves the area with zero eligible jurors.

Since federal law dictates that a jury must be selected from the exact state and district where a crime occurs, but absolutely nobody lives in this specific Idaho intersection of the park, a legal trial cannot physically form.

While the government would desperately try to prosecute you anyway, this terrifying legal glitch remains completely untested, so would you ever dare to camp in this creepy place? Follow for more insane legal secrets!
